summary: Independent review found no P0/P1: the legacy protected-conflict path requires an exact token-bound adoption receipt before any semantic CODER route, and the additive CLI surface is fully registered in the v0.7 compatibility ledger.
findings: The adoption command recomputes live route state under the queue mutex, binds provider, handoff, queue, base topology, and token, and fails closed when any input changes.
The v0.6.24 immutable baseline remains unchanged; the v0.7 candidate records the exact new command, option, counts, digests, and 9M7RNH provenance.
evidence_refs: bunx vitest --config vitest.workspace.ts run --project agentplane targeted-conflict-workflow
residual_risks: INTEGRATOR is an existing lifecycle role rather than cryptographic caller authentication; this rework preserves that authority model and does not expand it.
